name: point-of-care
description: What the people and systems at the point of care do in any DAK, whatever its health domain: a health worker completes an SDC form and the system extracts its resources (process questionnaire-data-capture.bpmn); the system applies a PlanDefinition, the health worker accepts or declines the guidance, may note why, and the system updates the care plan (process act-on-decision-support.bpmn). A DAK's own roles carry these skills and its BPMN calls the two processes; nothing here names a health domain.
